name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began, oddly enough, with a fascination for complex supply chains. Growing up in the Highlands, he was captivated by how goods moved across vast distances. This led him to a degree in logistics management, but his passion was always cars. He volunteered at local rally events, quickly realizing the crucial role of efficient logistics in a racing team. He started as a junior assistant, learning the ropes of transportation, inventory, and trackside support. 

Over the years, Alistair honed his skills in some of the most demanding motorsport environments, from Formula racing to endurance events. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure, his ability to anticipate potential problems, and his unwavering commitment to getting the right equipment to the right place at the right time. He approaches logistics as a strategic advantage, not just a necessary function. He sees himself as the oil that keeps the machine running smoothly. Alistair prides himself on finding innovative solutions, especially under pressure, and believes that a well-executed logistics plan can be the difference between victory and defeat. 

Alistair is looking to join a team where his experience and drive can make a real impact. He thrives in high-pressure environments, enjoys the challenge of problem-solving, and is always seeking ways to improve efficiency and effectiveness. He is particularly interested in teams that embrace data-driven decision-making and value a collaborative approach.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed ginger beard with a buzzcut.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of reciting obscure Scottish proverbs during stressful situations.
Insists on having a specific brand of Scottish shortbread available at every race.
